facts.statement: The genus Songlingornis was described by Hou in 1997.
Fossils of Songlingornis have been found in the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: Its fossils have been found in the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning (PRC).

facts.statement: The age of the rocks containing Songlingornis fossils is disputed but is likely around 125 to 120 million years ago.
facts.quote: The age of these rocks is somewhat disputed, but probably around the early Aptian, 125-120 million years ago.

facts.statement: Songlingornis belongs to the parent group Hongshanornithidae.
The time range for Songlingornis is estimated from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Songlingornis is an extinct genus of ornithuromorph dinosaurs.
rejected.quote: Songlingornis is an extinct genus of ornithuromorph dinosaurs

rejected.statement: It is sometimes considered to be the same genus as Yanornis, though this is not universally accepted.
